text:
nina: I opened a compact PR for docs: structured-output migration + small SDK shims for tool calling. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/953 — need reviewers for the examples, guardrails and the fallback parsing snippets.

caio: reading. quick question: do we standardize on a single canonical response object or keep a small set of supported shapes? SDKs prefer determinism.

nina: propose a clear canonical: {\"type\": \"action\", \"payload\": {...}} for new examples. keep a legacy appendix showing how to shim older array/union envelopes.

harper: added TS + Python snippets to the PR. tiny normalize helper included. TS example: ```ts
export type Canonical = {type: string; payload?: Record<string, unknown>};
export function normalize(resp: any): Canonical { if (Array.isArray(resp)) resp = resp[0]; if (typeof resp === 'string') try { resp = JSON.parse(resp) } catch {} return {type: resp?.type || 'unknown', payload: resp?.payload || {}} }
```

caio: CI flagged a broken link to /docs/old/tool-call.md

docs-bot: link-checker: /docs/old/tool-call.md -> 404 (line 44)

nina: thanks, will swap to /docs/reference/tool-calling.md and push a fix.

harper: please add short guardrails at the top of the doc: prefer a top-level object, avoid top-level anyOf unions, and when invoking tools include a single `tool_call` object with `name` and `arguments`. keeps parsers small and predictable.

caio: also add a pragmatic "fallback parser" snippet — we keep getting partial streams and escaped-JSON-in-strings. sample I like: ```py
# best-effort fallback
try:
    out = json.loads(text)
except json.JSONDecodeError:
    m = re.search(r"\{(?:[^{}]|(?R))*\}", text, re.S)  # extract first braced object
    out = json.loads(m.group(0)) if m else {"error":"parse_failed"}
```

nina: hmm that recursive regex may be heavy; add a simpler fallback first: search for first {.*} with DOTALL and then try safe loads. include both in the doc as options.

harper: added a note about tool argument size — recommend keeping serialized `arguments` under 8KB to avoid KV/cache churn and latency cliffs. included a tiny trimming helper in TS and Python.

docs-bot: docs build precheck: snippet index missing a permalink to /docs/sdk/snippets/tool_helpers.md

nina: pushed a permalink fix and a short changelog entry. plan: merge if CI green by Thursday 11:00 PT. please react to approve. :rocket:

caio: LGTM aside from one wording nit on the guardrails. left a suggestion.

harper: LGTM, added small test prompt in the examples so reviewers can reproduce the common failure mode: \"Call the `weather.fetch` tool for \\\"Berlin\\\" and return a `tool_call` object with `arguments` as an object.\"

build-bot: PR checks queued. Will report back when green.

nina: great — if CI passes I'll merge and trigger the docs site rebuild. I'll also notify the Integrations channel so SDK owners can sanity-check permalinks.

caio: one more ask: add a tiny section showing how to write a shim that maps older `call_tool` fields to `tool_call` so customers can migrate with minimal code changes.

nina: added that migration shim and an example unit test. merging plan stands.

harper: thanks all — nice compact PR.

nina: thanks everyone. will merge on green. :white_check_mark:
